stages.name: Plan
stages.does: Turns the ask into searches, hashtags and a keep/drop rule (what to look for, and what to keep).

stages.name: Pull
stages.does: Runs every search on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube; turns away ads, old posts and small posts at the door.

stages.name: Sift
stages.does: Sorts every new post into a lane: entertainment, educational, selling or junk. Only the first two stay.

kept.author: keepingupwitrayg27
kept.why: Prank and funny granny tags signal entertainment.

kept.author: ahnestkitchen
kept.why: Explicit routine explanation with no sponsorship or pitch.

kept.author: jackneedsajob
kept.why: Empty caption does not disqualify entertainment; content is unread.

kept.author: itsbabykelz

kept.author: mindaylee_

kept.author: all.things.amari

kept.author: witchy.lashes

kept.author: dino.judy

kept.author: amiga6589
kept.why: Gives procedural instructions without an explicit sales pitch.

stages.name: Follow
stages.does: Follows the winners to the creators behind them and seats those creators on trial.
stages.model: no model — follows the edges (links to the creators)

stages.name: Repeat
stages.does: Every Pull runs stages 2–4 again on the feed.
